deficiencies.description: The lecturer uses the demonstrative pronoun 'this' ('this is probably an obligatory step'), which is ambiguous and refers back to an unclear preceding state. The rewrite resolves this pointing word into the specific description 'Invasion', which is an unsourced addition.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So this is probably an obligatory step in getting to having a malignant metastasizing tumor.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Invasion is therefore probably an obligatory step in getting to having a malignant, metastasising tumour.
